stemBlocks: The sex of species Q is controlled by two chromosomes X and Y. The sex of females of species Q is controlled by inheriting the same combination of sex chromosomes as healthy male humans. The sex of males in species Q is inherited in the same way as healthy female humans. The family tree for one population of species Q is shown.
What is the ratio in its simplest form of males to females and the total number of Y chromosomes in this family tree?
